$comment: THE twelve conditions a Universal Foundation freeze requires. Each names the KIND of evidence that can discharge it, so a criterion is never satisfied by assertion. A criterion whose evidence was not gathered is reported UNMEASURED and withholds readiness exactly as firmly as a failure — a freeze declared over unmeasured criteria is the failure a freeze exists to prevent. Adding a condition is an entry here and requires NO change to freeze.py.

criteria.rationale: Measured as surplus live implementations across every declared constitutional model. One model, one implementation — a second is a duplicate architecture, not a choice.
Every constitutional model has exactly one canonical owner publishing exactly one contract surface.
The ownership model must have one live answer. Verified by proving the retired engine-side resolver is absent and every remaining ownership surface reaches the one framework.
Every consumer classifies Truth through the one declared policy; no surface carries a second idea of which locations may own.
A probe that cannot execute means the architecture cannot be measured, which is precisely what 'unresolved' means. Zero FAULT verdicts is the condition.
Every capability registers into a fresh certified registry, that registry validates, and the service resolves to a live instance.
A contract surface is published, and one declared semantic version governs the whole of it — the contract refs and the registered service contract alike.
Every declared policy document resolves and parses, and the capability composed from it is content-addressed and byte-identical across two independent builds.
Every declared dependency is a registered Foundation capability and is really imported; the composition graph is acyclic.

criteria.requirement: All Foundation dependencies resolve to a total composition order
criteria.rationale: Separate from FZ-09: a graph can have every edge satisfied and still not admit a total order. The order is derived, not asserted, and a cycle is refused.

The repository's own canonical test and coverage gate. Measured only when explicitly requested, because executing a full suite inside a readiness determination would make the determination non-deterministic in cost; when not executed it is reported UNMEASURED and readiness is withheld.

criteria.requirement: All Foundation verification and certification complete
criteria.rationale: Every capability reaches every declared maturity axis, and the platform-scoped articles pass. Anything below 100% names the axis that is not yet reached rather than rounding it away.
